'''Ralesk''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who served as one of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Grathan]]'s top [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]], he was sent by Lord Grathan to eliminate [[Empire's Wrath|Darth Baras' apprentice]] for murdering [[Beelzlit Grathan|Beelzlit]] and [[Cellvanta Grathan]]. Ralesk was present in the hangar when the apprentice was given a mission to track down [[Nomen Karr]] and [[Jaesa Willsaam]]. Ralesk engaged the [[Sith Warrior]] to impress his master, but was killed by the apprentice.<ref name="TOR" />
